concept.title: Same Shoulders
concept.hook: Macro of a folded charcoal tee on a folded hoodie, clay-soft 3D, cotton weave visible. Overlay: Heavy cotton. Boxy cut. Nothing to explain.
concept.surpriseBeat: After the washing drum, the tee and hoodie slide out and settle in slow motion with the same square shoulders and crisp hem as before.

locations.description: Minimal 3D studio set with a pale warm backdrop
locations.lighting: Warm studio key light, soft shadows

locations.description: Tiny stylized laundry room with a front-load washer
locations.lighting: Warm soft key light with gentle grain

scenes.action: The folded tee on the folded hoodie sits centered on the pale backdrop. Slow push toward the weave of the cotton.
scenes.framing: Macro on the stack, edges of both garments readable
scenes.motion: Camera moves only; stack is still
scenes.lighting: Warm studio key light, soft shadows
scenes.overlayText: Heavy cotton. Boxy cut. Nothing to explain.
scenes.sound: Lo-fi hip hop at about 88 bpm, dusty drums, soft electric piano, light vinyl crackle

scenes.action: A relaxed stylized adult character pulls the tee on and it drops into a boxy shape with relaxed shoulders.
scenes.framing: Medium shot, character centered against the backdrop
scenes.motion: Unhurried pull-on, fabric falls and settles
scenes.sound: Soft cloth rustle, round sub bass note on the beat

scenes.action: The brushed fleece hoodie is zipped around a shoulder. The fleece compresses, then springs back.
scenes.framing: Close on the shoulder, fleece fibers visible
scenes.motion: Slow zip, fabric compresses and rebounds
scenes.lighting: Warm key light with soft shadows
scenes.sound: Soft zipper glide, muted fleece press

scenes.action: Both garments tumble through the washing drum, then slide out onto the surface and settle in slow motion with square shoulders and a crisp hem.
scenes.framing: Front view of the washer door, then the garments settling
scenes.motion: Slow tumble, then slow-motion fabric settle
scenes.sound: Gentle drum hum, then a soft hush as the fabric settles

scenes.action: The stack is re-folded and held on the pale backdrop. The camera pulls back to a medium shot.
scenes.overlayText: Small runs. One small symbol. Prices at the end.
scenes.sound: Piano chord resolves, vinyl crackle fades

rubric.reason: Directly follows the brief's wear and wash montage with the product as hero. The surprise is quiet by design, so it scores moderately.

concept.title: Stitch by Stitch
concept.hook: Extreme macro of a circle-and-line symbol being stitched into charcoal cotton, thread appearing stitch by stitch on the beat. Overlay: One small symbol.
concept.surpriseBeat: The macro pulls out in one move to reveal the tiny embroidered symbol sits on a full boxy tee worn by a relaxed character.

locations.description: Minimal 3D studio set with a pale warm backdrop
locations.lighting: Warm studio key light, soft shadows

scenes.action: Macro of the circle-and-line symbol appearing stitch by stitch on charcoal cotton, weave visible.
scenes.framing: Extreme macro on fabric and thread
scenes.motion: Stitches appear one by one on the beat
scenes.sound: Dusty lo-fi drums at about 88 bpm, a tick for each stitch

scenes.action: The folded tee on the folded hoodie sits on the backdrop. The camera moves around the stack.
scenes.framing: Medium close on the stack from every side
scenes.overlayText: Boxy heavyweight tee. Brushed fleece hoodie.
scenes.sound: Soft electric piano chords, round sub bass

scenes.action: A character pulls the hoodie on and the brushed fleece compresses, then springs back.
The macro pulls out to reveal the symbol on the chest of a boxy tee worn by the relaxed character, who stands with an easy posture.
scenes.framing: Starts macro on the stitches, ends medium shot
scenes.motion: Character stands still while the camera pulls back

scenes.action: The character steps out of frame, leaving the folded stack in a held end frame.
scenes.framing: Stack centered on the pale backdrop
scenes.overlayText: Small runs. Prices at the end.

rubric.reason: The macro stitch opening is distinctive and uses the brief's symbol detail. The reveal is pleasant, though the product is worn more than it is tested.

concept.title: Third Wash
concept.hook: A charcoal tee dropped into a washing drum, spinning at the glass. Overlay: Most tees give up by the third wash.
concept.surpriseBeat: After the spin, the tee tumbles out and snaps to its boxy shape with square shoulders, while a limp generic shirt is not shown, only the crisp hem holds.

locations.description: Tiny stylized laundry room with a front-load washer
Sunlit dorm-style bedroom with a shelf and a chair

scenes.action: The charcoal tee and hoodie tumble behind the front-load washer glass.
scenes.framing: Front view of the washer door filling the frame
scenes.overlayText: Most tees give up by the third wash.
scenes.sound: Lo-fi hip hop at about 88 bpm, soft drum hum under it

scenes.action: The door opens and the folded tee on the folded hoodie is lifted out and set on the counter.
scenes.framing: Medium shot of the stack on the counter

scenes.action: In the sunlit bedroom, a second adult character hangs the hoodie on a chair back.
scenes.framing: Medium shot, chair and shelf in view
scenes.sound: Quiet room tone, soft electric piano

scenes.action: The relaxed character pulls the tee on and it drops into its boxy shape. Slow motion at the 8 second mark shows the fabric settle with square shoulders.
scenes.framing: Medium close on the shoulders and hem
scenes.sound: Round sub bass hold, cloth hush

scenes.action: The camera pulls back to the stack on the shelf, held end frame.
scenes.framing: Stack on shelf, bedroom softly visible
scenes.overlayText: Small runs. Prices at the end.

rubric.reason: The hook line comes from the brief and the bedroom adds warmth. The surprise description is muddled and the first frame is less striking than the macro concepts.
